subject: Nuclear Protein Acinus Drives Autophagy through Rab32 and Lrrk Kinase
script: From Agewell Brief: Nuclear Protein Acinus Drives Autophagy through Rab32 and Lrrk Kinase. When proteostasis stress forces nuclear protein Acinus into the cytoplasm, it bypasses mTOR to ignite a distinct autophagic pathway dependent on Rab32 and Lrrk. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
